messages:
Maya (sales): Heads-up: AtlasHealth POC next Tue. They want a 48h smoke + throughput check. Need reserved GPU preheat plan, autoscale JSON, and security Q responses.
Leo (solutions): Whats the expected traffic shape? burst qps vs steady, avg tokens?
Maya (sales): Bursts to ~220 qps for ~2-5m, baseline ~50 qps. Typical generation ~80-120 tokens. Little embedding.
Tara (infra): Recommend reserved 5 GPUs, burst credits for +4 GPUs up to 3m, autoscale to 10 if sustained. Autoscale triggers: queued_requests + p95_latency.
Nina (sre): Agree on burst credits to avoid cold starts. Also will add eviction tolerance doc.
Ibrahim (security): For questionnaire: Dedicated offers VPC peering or private deployment, customer KMS, SOC2 Type II, console IP allowlist. Send the PDF and Ill draft answers.
Leo (solutions): Pricing note: if they accept quantized model variants (q8), expect ~+25% throughput; propose 12% reserved SKU discount for quant commitment. Will add to quote.
Tara (infra): Preheat snippet: seed top prompts, run 10qps warmer 10m, check kv_cache_hit_rate >60% and p95 latency. JSON for autoscale below.
Tara (infra): {"autoscale":"{\"min_reserved\":5,\"max_reserved\":10,\"scale_step_secs\":30,\"burst_credit_threshold_secs\":180,\"metrics\":[\"queued_requests\",\"p95_latency\"]}"}
DeployBot: Scheduled atlas_poc_smoke for 2026-05-12T16:00:00Z. Report will be posted in thread.
Maya (sales): Thanks all  I'll share the security PDF now.
